vo: Day 1: my adult hoodies hit the port. No CPSC rule, right?
Then customs. My broker: where's the G C C for the hoodies?
The catch? Part sixteen ten covers clothing textiles. Adults too.
So my G C C lists part sixteen ten, and I check how the fleece was tested.
Blocked right now? Forward the notice. Get your gap list in twenty-four hours.
caps: Say I'm a seller. My adult cotton fleece hoodies arrive.
The truck stops at the gate.
Myth: adult clothes have no rule.
Fact: 16 CFR part 1610 covers clothing textiles.
